programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Introducing you to Squirrel Club are Happy’s Mum and Norrie’s Dad. There is a lot to see, starting with Duggee walking by... in two halves! Next is an instalment of the Squirrels' favourite comic book, Detective Puppy, then it's time to find out what the Rabbits think is cool and not cool. There are plenty of questions asked during this visit, and the Squirrels need to help Delivery Chipmunk with a ginormous parcel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can’t stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee’s dream!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with their cousins, but Muffin won’t give Socks a turn.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to fix the Leaning Tower of Pisa, but has it really been glitched?

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter is asked to watch Jemima's egg, he discovers that babysitting is far more dangerous than he could ever have imagined.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. When the Octonauts are unable to rescue a group of narwhals trapped behind Arctic ice, they recruit a bowhead whale to help them break through!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Seven shows the others how to be lucky: ask a number friend to jump on your head! But how do you know which friend? Find out how to tell the difference between two numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: OO and friends discover a talking book, some missing words and a pile of letters - can they put the story of Little Red Riding Hood back together? This episode introduces the '-oo-' digraph and the words book, hood, cool, moon, woof, good, boot, cook and food.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Today is the hedgehog picnic, but the meadow is full of rubbish. Hugh heads into town with his ukulele to save the day. Will his litter-picking song help get the picnic back on track? The Popcast Planners think so.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift are visited by a shining, shimmering star, and together they set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. In Boxtropolis, Sketch makes shooting, whooshing stars with the Playtimers. Kingsley and Queenie play a game of 'Big Star, Little Star' in the Fortress of Fun. And in the Cloud Kitchen, Patch needs the Playtimers' help to make scrummy Starfish Party Plates.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula, Pando, Flop and Padget all have a knack, a special thing that only they can do. Bing is frustrated when all his own knacks are easy for everyone else to do too. When Pando accidentally hurts Bing's ear, they are all in for a surprise, as Bing discovers he does have a knack that no-one else can do.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘alien’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We meet lots of different aliens – a green alien with feelers from outer space, a quick one and an alien doing a trick. Dee tries to find a hiding alien, and then Dee and a friend see aliens with different numbers of eyes. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu has fun playing with Elodie's cousin, and Elodie feels left out.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou’s drumming makes Kiri feel funny and wobbly all over. Pania explains that there’s nothing wrong - it’s called dancing.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff, Pipp and Button become painters using honey, colourful petals and an old pizza box.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Stop-motion preschool programme. The Twirlywoos meet a soft and fluffy cat. The Box visits the boat and this time it is filled with soft balls of fluff.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Ellis to explore emotions. They relax in a sensory room, stroke a therapy dog and join George to play with modelling dough. Mr Tumble is trying to chill out but keeps getting interrupted. There are some calming crafts in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words bubbles, calm and dough.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: During the Tiddlytubbies' Sleepybyes, RuRu is wide awake. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to sing him a lullaby. When the Teletubbies sing the lullaby together, it sends RuRu off to sleep.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Marta, Billie, Hud, Elijah, Thomas, Finley and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag is a rubber duck, and all the parents and babies have different bath toys in their bags which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding a baby appropriate rubber duck or bath toy inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The nursery rhyme Three Little Ducks features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children play with rubber ducks, learning BSL signs for ducks, far away and swimming, then sing and sign Five Little Ducks Went Swimming One Day.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Novah, Nelly and Aaron are all ears as they discover lots of different sounds in the city centre garden - from tweeting birds and rustling leaves, to cars and a crane!

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca has lost her healthy, fruity snacks. Murphi can’t find them either, but he does find a huge portrait of his great-grandma with the big eyes. This gives him an 'eye-dea' for a make – a pair of silly eyeglasses! The Mini Monsters make muffins, Rebecca gets a call on the Magic Monster Mirror from her aunt, and Murphi and Rebecca create a snack tube train with some support from the Tiny Helpers and the Recycling Express.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger’s baby Broccolisaurus friend kicks their ball into Potatodon territory.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song - all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now? Duggee offers to repair Delivery Chipmunk’s trike, but that will take too long. The packages need to be delivered right away or else! Duggee also has a delivery badge and he will try to deliver all of Chipmunk’s packages with the help of the Squirrels. Before they begin, they need to learn the rules of delivering. With some hard work, the Squirrels deliver all the packages and Delivery Chipmunk is alright again. The Squirrels have truly earned their delivery badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Let’s all be groovy like the Rabbits! You might find there’s more fun in being kind.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to the library. On the way they count the domes on a temple, pretend to be trains, swirl like a barber’s pole and even discover a jungle!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Audrey is very good at sports! In this episode, she has a table tennis lesson with her coaches Tim and Harry. First, she practices some bat and ball skills before enjoying a rally against Harry (who is an actual table tennis champion!) Later, the whole family get sporty and have some fun playing mini-golf, and Audrey puts Mum through her paces with a very bendy yoga lesson.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Choekyi has been shown a traditional way to make momos, which are a type of dumpling. First, Choekyi makes dough that is then rolled out into circles. She fills these circles with a mixture of spinach, cheese and mushrooms. When they tried mushrooms at first, Choekyi’s friends did not really like the taste or smell. Let’s hope they prefer them when they are cooked in the momos. Choekyi’s recipe comes from Tibet, so when her friends arrive she greets them in a traditional Tibetan way.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie is finding out about the life cycle of plants! She visits a gigantic tomato growing farm and uses her special time-lapse camera to discover how a plant germinates from a seed and grows into a shoot. Next, she travels in a lift to the top of the high greenhouse to see the flowers and tomato fruits growing. We learn how the plant needs water, sunlight and carbon dioxide to make its own energy to grow. Next, Maddie heads to a compost farm to see how compost is made from things we might throw away. She uses a special microscopic camera to see wriggly worms, insects and bacteria that help break down the waste to make useful compost we can grow plants in.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Therapy dog Toffee and his owner Helen help Betty and Pop-Pop feel brave enough to perform at their talent show at the Woofton Care Home.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet a troop of spider monkeys and watch how they use their long tails like a fifth hand to grab and balance as they swing through the trees. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Gilly the tamandua. They see how this tree-living ant eater finds food using his long, sticky tongue. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's the morning of Evie's first day at school and the Brooklyn-Bells are on schedule. But Waffle isn't happy as he is expecting his usual morning walkies. Doug tells Waffle that Gramps will be walking him today; he'll be coming to the house later. Waffle is insistent, he wants to walk to school with the rest of the family…now! Evie thinks it's a great idea. She's nervous about starting Reception and walking to school with Waffle will make her feel happy.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Everyone needs help sometimes, Oona just has to learn to ask.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. Chip sings a heartfelt song about being a potato. Though he can't do many physical things, he is proud of who he is.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee’s garden friends help turn her ‘a day in my life’ homework assignment into an exciting, musical sound adventure.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are off on a hill walk with Mum – but it’s just not the same without Dad. As they wander through the windy hills, they meet a new friend who introduces them to the wonders of yodelling. That gives Maddie an idea... maybe they can reach Dad after all?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are in the Clubhouse, and everything seems the same, except… Duggee! They can’t quite put their finger on what it is, so to help, the Squirrels have to learn how to spot the difference through three different games.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The animated adventures of friends who can always count on each other. Five and friends set off on a rhyming romp through a field and forest, but they keep getting mixed up.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Meet the Alphablocks! From accident-prone A to sleepy Z, all twenty-six letters are full of fun and ready for adventure.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a planetarium where they learn all about outer space. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble tries to spot a shooting star using his new telescope.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are outside in the cold when they spot the Tiddlytubbies who are inside and warm. The Teletubbies put on hats, gloves and scarves to keep warm.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how mosses play an important role in the environment. They find out that they can be home to lots of different creatures, even tiny creatures we can’t see with our eyes, and that birds can use moss to build their nests. On the way, they visit a peat bog made up of sphagnum moss and see just how much water moss can drink up when Ranger Hamza gives it a squeeze!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Elvis refuses to play football after his lucky, stinky socks are washed. Evie B leads the hunt for the smelliest smell in the Den so they can make the socks stinky again.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, Grace shows off three amazing machines that are all made to race! First, Grace has a race on her lake on a stand-up jet ski. Then she shows off the incredibly fast Bloodhound car and goes for a ride on a sidecar motorbike!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: In the playground, there's wet paint on the brand new climbing frame. Miss Collie tells the pups they are not to play on the climbing frame - or even go near it. The temptation becomes too much for the pups. When the playtime bell goes off, the pups rush back into school, and Dodge is accidentally knocked into the wet paint. Dodge, Jazz and Woofer try to cover up their tracks - only to make the situation worse. The pups come to the realisation that they need to own up and tell the truth.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster debates whether to share a box of chocolates with his friends or not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can’t figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea. A mobile library! The Squirrels set off with Duggee. Along the way, they help Tino find his creativity, King Tiger figure out his favourite ice cream flavour and Worm find her love of fantasy. The Squirrels learn just how helpful and informative a library can be!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Zigzag's toes are sore, Vida gets her back on track for the Sweetwood relay race.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Banana Superstar’s show is stopped when Evil Pea steals his peel. Supertato races against him to get it back, but trouble hits when a giant banana statue collapses onto the stage.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Chipmunk accidentally gets hit by a ball during a game of baseball. To make him feel better, the ducklings feed him popcorn. The Chipmunk pretends to be sick to get more and more privileges. Weasy has had enough!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo join the big cross-town race with plans to win. But how can they stay ahead when they have to keep stopping and swopping to help other racers in trouble?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with their cousins, but Muffin won’t give Socks a turn.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: With Pearl entranced by Fifi’s glowing tummy mushrooms, Zog fears the worst when Gadabout attempts to mend Boom's wing himself.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: When Dr Ollie discovers the Story Bus is delayed, he vows to save the day by inventing a new story to tell Miss Hoolie and the children.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: When Jess takes Evie for her first school visit, Waffle goes along too - on the condition that he doesn't sing. He tries his best to behave, but it's hard for a Wonder Dog! On their walk to school, Jess and Evie bump into Connie Lester and her daughter Ruby. Ruby reveals that she will also be starting at Sommersby School too, in the year above Evie. Ruby enjoys stroking Waffle and tells Evie that she loves animals. She has a pet dog of her own, Jelly, a yellow labrador. Waffle introduces himself to Jelly, but decides Jelly is a grumpy dog. Meanwhile, there's a For Sale sign in Mrs Hobbs' front garden. Mrs Hobbs and George are moving house and leaving Maple Close forever.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi is disappointed when she can’t join her dad, Dash, at a grown-up restaurant, while Aunty T would much rather spend the afternoon playing in the park. With a mischievous idea and a little magic, Rafi wishes they could switch places. When the wish wears off, Rafi realises that some things are best enjoyed when you’re exactly who you’re meant to be.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: Gran Gran busts a groove when she teaches JoJo the moves to a traditional Saint Lucian dance. JoJo finds that learning a dance can take time, before realising she can put her own twist on it.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. When Sarah has a cold, Duck helps her enjoy a visit to the doctor.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Small is out fishing and Baby Soup Dragon is helping his mum, so Tiny has no-one to play with. He plays catch by himself but it’s not much fun. Major Clanger notices that Tiny looks bored and makes him a special cone-shaped gadget which launches a cotton ball up into the air for the user to catch in the cone. Mother calls Tiny to ask for some help in the garden and Tiny leaves the gadget on the floor while she goes off to help her mum. But when she gets back, the gadget has disappeared.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo has a lovely bag to carry things around. A Tweetie brings MeMo a felt star, so MeMo puts it in the bag. At Play Time, BaBa wants to keep a stacking ring - MeMo puts it in the bag as well. MeMo gives the star to the Play Tree to make room. At Yummy Time, they use the ring to replace the wheel on the cart. Crossing Lullaby Lake, MeMo’s bag is empty, but that’s okay because they have had a very full day.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Makka Pakka is walking in the garden when he comes across some stones which he decides to clean. Makka Pakka trips over a stone, and his sponge flies off straight into Upsy Daisy's megaphone. How is Makka Pakka going to get his sponge back?

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: What is art? Join musician St. Vincent for a Bedtime Story about a little boy who wonders the same thing when he visits an art gallery.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s young Asparagus, sharing his deep affection for wet weather in the song I Love the Rain.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Pando experiment with Bing's toy train on the Fun Fort in the playground. The train is good at going over bridges and brilliant at going down the slide. But when Bing slides it off the roof of the playhouse, the train crashes and breaks. Bing is upset until he realises that the pieces fit together to make something completely different.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky keeps standing in the way of Laa-Laa's view of the flowers, but Laa-Laa likes looking at Tinky Winky just as much as the flowers. The Teletubbies watch a Tummy Tale where children play hide-and-seek.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Tee wakes up in a grumpy mood. He is even too grumpy for breakfast! It is up to Mo to put a smile on Tee's face, but this proves more difficult than she thought. Every time she gets him close to smiling, he slips back into the grumps again. How is Mo going to cheer Tee up and get him to eat breakfast?

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: The Tato Team are playing beach volleyball. But when Evil Pea's parents, Mummy Pea and Daddy Pea, pay her a visit, they are disappointed to learn that she doesn't rule the supermarket. They vow to help their daughter defeat Supertato once and for all. After cornering him with three freezy hoses and freezing his super sidekicks, it looks like Evil Pea might finally be victorious. But when she is distracted, Supertato and the veggies use their beach volleyball to block the attack and the plan backfires... freezing her parents instead!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula and Bing are camping in Bing's garden in order to see the stars and the moon. As Flop goes back for Hoppity, night-time noises seep from the dark garden, spooking Bing. Then, a scary shape on the tent terrifies him. They go inside, but the monster has followed them in! Bing and Sula discover that Flop is the monster. So they go back outside, where the billion, zillion stars and a huge moon are waiting for them.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Bryan the ferry can’t shut his engine off, so he’s speeding out of control around the lake. How will Mojo and Bo get aboard to take control and steer Bryan to safety?

She fills these circles with a mixture of spinach, cheese and mushrooms. When they tried mushrooms at first, Choekyi’s friends did not really like the taste or smell. Let’s hope they prefer them when they are cooked in the momos. Choekyi’s recipe comes from Tibet, so when her friends arrive she greets them in a traditional Tibetan way.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie is finding out about the life cycle of plants! She visits a gigantic tomato growing farm and uses her special time-lapse camera to discover how a plant germinates from a seed and grows into a shoot. Next, she travels in a lift to the top of the high greenhouse to see the flowers and tomato fruits growing. We learn how the plant needs water, sunlight and carbon dioxide to make its own energy to grow. Next, Maddie heads to a compost farm to see how compost is made from things we might throw away. She uses a special microscopic camera to see wriggly worms, insects and bacteria that help break down the waste to make useful compost we can grow plants in.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Therapy dog Toffee and his owner Helen help Betty and Pop-Pop feel brave enough to perform at their talent show at the Woofton Care Home.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet a troop of spider monkeys and watch how they use their long tails like a fifth hand to grab and balance as they swing through the trees. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Gilly the tamandua. They see how this tree-living ant eater finds food using his long, sticky tongue. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's the morning of Evie's first day at school and the Brooklyn-Bells are on schedule. But Waffle isn't happy as he is expecting his usual morning walkies. Doug tells Waffle that Gramps will be walking him today; he'll be coming to the house later. Waffle is insistent, he wants to walk to school with the rest of the family…now! Evie thinks it's a great idea. She's nervous about starting Reception and walking to school with Waffle will make her feel happy.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Everyone needs help sometimes, Oona just has to learn to ask.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. Chip sings a heartfelt song about being a potato. Though he can't do many physical things, he is proud of who he is.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee’s garden friends help turn her ‘a day in my life’ homework assignment into an exciting, musical sound adventure.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are off on a hill walk with Mum – but it’s just not the same without Dad. As they wander through the windy hills, they meet a new friend who introduces them to the wonders of yodelling. That gives Maddie an idea... maybe they can reach Dad after all?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are in the Clubhouse, and everything seems the same, except… Duggee! They can’t quite put their finger on what it is, so to help, the Squirrels have to learn how to spot the difference through three different games.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The animated adventures of friends who can always count on each other. Five and friends set off on a rhyming romp through a field and forest, but they keep getting mixed up.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Meet the Alphablocks! From accident-prone A to sleepy Z, all twenty-six letters are full of fun and ready for adventure.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a planetarium where they learn all about outer space. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble tries to spot a shooting star using his new telescope.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are outside in the cold when they spot the Tiddlytubbies who are inside and warm. The Teletubbies put on hats, gloves and scarves to keep warm.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how mosses play an important role in the environment. They find out that they can be home to lots of different creatures, even tiny creatures we can’t see with our eyes, and that birds can use moss to build their nests. On the way, they visit a peat bog made up of sphagnum moss and see just how much water moss can drink up when Ranger Hamza gives it a squeeze!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Elvis refuses to play football after his lucky, stinky socks are washed. Evie B leads the hunt for the smelliest smell in the Den so they can make the socks stinky again.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, Grace shows off three amazing machines that are all made to race! First, Grace has a race on her lake on a stand-up jet ski. Then she shows off the incredibly fast Bloodhound car and goes for a ride on a sidecar motorbike!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: In the playground, there's wet paint on the brand new climbing frame. Miss Collie tells the pups they are not to play on the climbing frame - or even go near it. The temptation becomes too much for the pups. When the playtime bell goes off, the pups rush back into school, and Dodge is accidentally knocked into the wet paint. Dodge, Jazz and Woofer try to cover up their tracks - only to make the situation worse. The pups come to the realisation that they need to own up and tell the truth.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster debates whether to share a box of chocolates with his friends or not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can’t figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea. A mobile library! The Squirrels set off with Duggee. Along the way, they help Tino find his creativity, King Tiger figure out his favourite ice cream flavour and Worm find her love of fantasy. The Squirrels learn just how helpful and informative a library can be!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Zigzag's toes are sore, Vida gets her back on track for the Sweetwood relay race.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Banana Superstar’s show is stopped when Evil Pea steals his peel. Supertato races against him to get it back, but trouble hits when a giant banana statue collapses onto the stage.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Chipmunk accidentally gets hit by a ball during a game of baseball. To make him feel better, the ducklings feed him popcorn. The Chipmunk pretends to be sick to get more and more privileges. Weasy has had enough!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo join the big cross-town race with plans to win. But how can they stay ahead when they have to keep stopping and swopping to help other racers in trouble?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with their cousins, but Muffin won’t give Socks a turn.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: With Pearl entranced by Fifi’s glowing tummy mushrooms, Zog fears the worst when Gadabout attempts to mend Boom's wing himself.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: When Dr Ollie discovers the Story Bus is delayed, he vows to save the day by inventing a new story to tell Miss Hoolie and the children.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: When Jess takes Evie for her first school visit, Waffle goes along too - on the condition that he doesn't sing. He tries his best to behave, but it's hard for a Wonder Dog! On their walk to school, Jess and Evie bump into Connie Lester and her daughter Ruby. Ruby reveals that she will also be starting at Sommersby School too, in the year above Evie. Ruby enjoys stroking Waffle and tells Evie that she loves animals. She has a pet dog of her own, Jelly, a yellow labrador. Waffle introduces himself to Jelly, but decides Jelly is a grumpy dog. Meanwhile, there's a For Sale sign in Mrs Hobbs' front garden. Mrs Hobbs and George are moving house and leaving Maple Close forever.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi is disappointed when she can’t join her dad, Dash, at a grown-up restaurant, while Aunty T would much rather spend the afternoon playing in the park. With a mischievous idea and a little magic, Rafi wishes they could switch places. When the wish wears off, Rafi realises that some things are best enjoyed when you’re exactly who you’re meant to be.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: Gran Gran busts a groove when she teaches JoJo the moves to a traditional Saint Lucian dance. JoJo finds that learning a dance can take time, before realising she can put her own twist on it.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. When Sarah has a cold, Duck helps her enjoy a visit to the doctor.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Small is out fishing and Baby Soup Dragon is helping his mum, so Tiny has no-one to play with. He plays catch by himself but it’s not much fun. Major Clanger notices that Tiny looks bored and makes him a special cone-shaped gadget which launches a cotton ball up into the air for the user to catch in the cone. Mother calls Tiny to ask for some help in the garden and Tiny leaves the gadget on the floor while she goes off to help her mum. But when she gets back, the gadget has disappeared.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo has a lovely bag to carry things around. A Tweetie brings MeMo a felt star, so MeMo puts it in the bag. At Play Time, BaBa wants to keep a stacking ring - MeMo puts it in the bag as well. MeMo gives the star to the Play Tree to make room. At Yummy Time, they use the ring to replace the wheel on the cart. Crossing Lullaby Lake, MeMo’s bag is empty, but that’s okay because they have had a very full day.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Makka Pakka is walking in the garden when he comes across some stones which he decides to clean. Makka Pakka trips over a stone, and his sponge flies off straight into Upsy Daisy's megaphone. How is Makka Pakka going to get his sponge back?

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: What is art? Join musician St. Vincent for a Bedtime Story about a little boy who wonders the same thing when he visits an art gallery.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. With her time in Pleasant Court running out, Isabelle returns to a strange clue - as Barb prepares for the Eureka council hearing, Isabelle has some questions for her. Despite the protests, the development is approved and Ange has a much-needed win - however, it's short-lived as Clive tells her that he still wants out of the deal. As Ange feels that her world is crumbling, Isabelle learns that Barb has gifted Essie and Ben the family home - she suggests they celebrate and she will babysit. Questioning Barb's motives for leaving Pleasant Court, Isabelle takes the opportunity to search their house - at the same time, Ange is snooping through hers determined to find the truth of her hidden agenda. As Ange discovers Isabelle's true identity, Isabelle makes a huge discovery...

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The final part of the Australian mystery drama. After a restless night, Isabelle is burdened with her discovery - now she has the truth, she must consider if she is prepared to destroy one family to heal another. Meanwhile, Pleasant Court prepares for a street party as an increasingly anxious Barb quietly tidies up her affairs, and Ange is also wrestling with the truth as she knows why Isabelle is at Pleasant Court - when she confronts her, Isabelle deflects by dropping a bombshell of her own. Fran retreats and reveals to Nigel how she's been feeling, but his reaction is unexpected - with the street party in ruins and each family affected by Isabelle's investigation, a broken Ange insists that everyone has lunch together. When they realise that Barb and Mia are missing, Isabelle is panicked - fearing history is repeating itself, she wrestles with the truth and eventually reveals what it was that brought her to Pleasant Court.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. With her time in Pleasant Court running out, Isabelle returns to a strange clue - as Barb prepares for the Eureka council hearing, Isabelle has some questions for her. Despite the protests, the development is approved and Ange has a much-needed win - however, it's short-lived as Clive tells her that he still wants out of the deal. As Ange feels that her world is crumbling, Isabelle learns that Barb has gifted Essie and Ben the family home - she suggests they celebrate and she will babysit. Questioning Barb's motives for leaving Pleasant Court, Isabelle takes the opportunity to search their house - at the same time, Ange is snooping through hers determined to find the truth of her hidden agenda. As Ange discovers Isabelle's true identity, Isabelle makes a huge discovery...

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The final part of the Australian mystery drama. After a restless night, Isabelle is burdened with her discovery - now she has the truth, she must consider if she is prepared to destroy one family to heal another. Meanwhile, Pleasant Court prepares for a street party as an increasingly anxious Barb quietly tidies up her affairs, and Ange is also wrestling with the truth as she knows why Isabelle is at Pleasant Court - when she confronts her, Isabelle deflects by dropping a bombshell of her own. Fran retreats and reveals to Nigel how she's been feeling, but his reaction is unexpected - with the street party in ruins and each family affected by Isabelle's investigation, a broken Ange insists that everyone has lunch together. When they realise that Barb and Mia are missing, Isabelle is panicked - fearing history is repeating itself, she wrestles with the truth and eventually reveals what it was that brought her to Pleasant Court.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. With her time in Pleasant Court running out, Isabelle returns to a strange clue - as Barb prepares for the Eureka council hearing, Isabelle has some questions for her. Despite the protests, the development is approved and Ange has a much-needed win - however, it's short-lived as Clive tells her that he still wants out of the deal. As Ange feels that her world is crumbling, Isabelle learns that Barb has gifted Essie and Ben the family home - she suggests they celebrate and she will babysit. Questioning Barb's motives for leaving Pleasant Court, Isabelle takes the opportunity to search their house - at the same time, Ange is snooping through hers determined to find the truth of her hidden agenda. As Ange discovers Isabelle's true identity, Isabelle makes a huge discovery...

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The final part of the Australian mystery drama. After a restless night, Isabelle is burdened with her discovery - now she has the truth, she must consider if she is prepared to destroy one family to heal another. Meanwhile, Pleasant Court prepares for a street party as an increasingly anxious Barb quietly tidies up her affairs, and Ange is also wrestling with the truth as she knows why Isabelle is at Pleasant Court - when she confronts her, Isabelle deflects by dropping a bombshell of her own. Fran retreats and reveals to Nigel how she's been feeling, but his reaction is unexpected - with the street party in ruins and each family affected by Isabelle's investigation, a broken Ange insists that everyone has lunch together. When they realise that Barb and Mia are missing, Isabelle is panicked - fearing history is repeating itself, she wrestles with the truth and eventually reveals what it was that brought her to Pleasant Court.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. With her time in Pleasant Court running out, Isabelle returns to a strange clue - as Barb prepares for the Eureka council hearing, Isabelle has some questions for her. Despite the protests, the development is approved and Ange has a much-needed win - however, it's short-lived as Clive tells her that he still wants out of the deal. As Ange feels that her world is crumbling, Isabelle learns that Barb has gifted Essie and Ben the family home - she suggests they celebrate and she will babysit. Questioning Barb's motives for leaving Pleasant Court, Isabelle takes the opportunity to search their house - at the same time, Ange is snooping through hers determined to find the truth of her hidden agenda. As Ange discovers Isabelle's true identity, Isabelle makes a huge discovery...

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The final part of the Australian mystery drama. After a restless night, Isabelle is burdened with her discovery - now she has the truth, she must consider if she is prepared to destroy one family to heal another. Meanwhile, Pleasant Court prepares for a street party as an increasingly anxious Barb quietly tidies up her affairs, and Ange is also wrestling with the truth as she knows why Isabelle is at Pleasant Court - when she confronts her, Isabelle deflects by dropping a bombshell of her own. Fran retreats and reveals to Nigel how she's been feeling, but his reaction is unexpected - with the street party in ruins and each family affected by Isabelle's investigation, a broken Ange insists that everyone has lunch together. When they realise that Barb and Mia are missing, Isabelle is panicked - fearing history is repeating itself, she wrestles with the truth and eventually reveals what it was that brought her to Pleasant Court.

programme.desc: Barnaby decides to join a trip from Midsomer Parva to Brighton because he is suspicious about a deal to buy coastal land for holiday chalets by Causton's mayor Dave Hicks - he discovers that the land wanted by Hicks is prone to flooding from the sea. Also against the proposal is Lady Matilda William, a descendant of a French knight Sir Richard Guillaume, whose son Richard will be the last of the line because of brain damage sustained in an attack 20 years ago - in Brighton, some of the villagers go to the funfair. When Dalgleish takes a ride on the ghost train, he emerges from the tunnel beheaded - Barnaby learns about a proposal to build flood defences which would make Hicks' land rocket in value and that Dalgleish lent Hicks money to bribe councillors to agree. Back in Midsomer, Barnaby realises there could be a connection between Dalgleish's greedy desire for land and Lady Matilda's desire to preserve the Guillaume family line... but who is prepared to kill to protect Richard?

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Crime drama series based on characters created by Ann Cleeves. DCI Vera Stanhope investigates when the body of the co-owner of a chip shop is found in his own freezer - a seemingly successful entrepreneur and dedicated family man, Vera uncovers secrets, lies and some unforgivable behaviour as she tries to unwrap the case. Once the investigation begins, it soon becomes apparent that our enigmatic entrepreneur has left behind debts, broken promises, ruined lives and seriously interfered in family business that was not his own - now Vera must find who is responsible for the this unsavoury chip shop assault and battery.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Crime drama. Geordie is still mourning Will's departure when Mrs C charges into the pub with reports of a gentleman breaking into the vicarage - Geordie leaps into action and heads straight inside the vicarage to confront the intruder. A tussle ensues between them before Geordie is confronted by the realisation that this man is no burglar - he's the new vicar. The man introduces himself as the Reverend Alphy Kottaram - as Alphy settles into life in Grantchester, his first order of business at the church is a funeral service for local landowner Albert Baron, who apparently took his own life - when the service is abruptly interrupted by the Walkers, a family warring with the Barons, a fight breaks out in the church. As the Walkers leave, Albert's son Harvey accuses the Walkers of murdering his father - as Alphy corrals the two families into the vicarage and Geordie arrives to investigate, an initially reluctant Alphy finds himself drawn into solving clues and uncovering buried secrets.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Crime drama. Alphy receives a mysterious letter in the post - this is the second time he's received post of its kind, but the meaning behind both letters entirely escapes him. Alphy doesn't have long to dwell on this because he has been invited to Marwood Manor for dinner and a party - Alphy plans to use this opportunity to drum up funds for the ailing church, but when Lady Marwood announces that it's time to play hide and seek, Alphy finds himself opening a cupboard while looking for a suitable hiding spot and is surprised to discover a dead body inside. The body is that of Dennis, the Marwoods' gardener who had apparently left the manor only a day before without a word - a blackmail letter is found on him, but it's not immediately clear whether the letter is addressed to Dennis or if he'd written it for someone else. As Alphy and Geordie investigate the murky world of the manor, they begin to uncover strange secrets and illicit desires amongst the residents and staff there.

programme.title: Scott & Bailey
programme.desc: Drama series following two detective constables in Manchester and written by BAFTA Award-winner Sally Wainwright. When DC Rachel Bailey is dumped, her best friend DC Janet Scott is there to pick up the pieces. Meanwhile, DCI Gill Murray takes Rachel, Janet and the team through their new murder case at work: a young Turkish woman has been killed in her home and her death made to look like suicide. Rachel throws herself into the investigation, soon discovering that the victim's husband was having an affair - she takes a risk when she questions the man's mistress, but has her high-stakes approach jeopardised the case, or will she get results? Rachel is also occupied with investigating her ex and is horrified to find that he is married with children - at the same time, Janet is contacted by the brother of a school friend who was abducted and murdered when they were still at primary school. He asks if she will reopen the case - and Janet agrees to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Scott & Bailey
programme.desc: Police drama following the personal and professional lives of two Manchester detectives. Things become even more complicated for Rachel when she reveals to her ex Nick that she is pregnant - and his unsympathetic response confirms her decision to have a termination. At work, the team face a gruesome case in which a mother of two has been brutally raped and left to bleed to death in the boot of her car. The team get a lucky break when CCTV footage reveals a man following the woman just before she disappeared - the same man who had been seen asking for a taxi to the Walden Estate. The police go to the estate to make house-to-house enquiries, and a sharp piece of detective work from Rachel leads to the arrest of teenager Luke Farrell. However, Luke's arrest sparks a series of events which leads to further tragedy, much to the horror of the team. Meanwhile, Janet steps up her investigation into her childhood friend Veronica's death and meets with an officer who investigated the murder.
